result.question: What must commanders do before seeing king's son?

readings.answer: Enter into a covenant and take an oath.
readings.support: There he made a covenant with them and put them under oath

readings.answer: Be brought into the house of the LORD.
readings.support: had them brought into the house of the LORD

The text states they were “brought into the house of the LORD” before he showed them the king’s son, so this is a prior step, though the key specifies the covenant and oath as the required action.
